Founded in <cite id="1">1993</cite>, the endowment supports direct-service interventions including <cite id="4">food distribution and water projects</cite> across regions like Pakistan, Gaza, and Yemen. Its structured focus on permanent capital ensures that long-term humanitarian initiatives remain viable over multi-decade time horizons.
